summary: A checkmating move that was also the hundredth half-move without a capture or pawn move (6k1/5ppp/8/8/8/8/8/R5K1 w - - 99 80, Ra8#) left the board's game status both checkmated and drawn, because the fifty-move count was read without regard to the mate. Checkmate ends the game first (FIDE 9.6.2). Fixed: the board status reports no draw once the position is checkmate.
